arcs.name: The Missing Stamp
arcs.summary: A Desperanza paperwork saga about a form that definitely exists somewhere.

beats.title: Form Trouble
beats.startText: Hatch Authority says {raider_name} is missing a deployment stamp. No one agrees on which stamp, only that it matters deeply.

HUB: Hatch Authority checked the form again. Still no stamp. Spirits remain heavily stamped, though.
Someone at the Permit Choir insists the missing stamp is emotional, not physical. This is less helpful than it sounds.
RAIDING: While looting, {raider_name} briefly wondered if the missing stamp is out here somewhere, hiding in a crate and judging everyone.

beats.title: Backup Bureaucracy
beats.startText: A backup stamp has been requested for {raider_name}. The request itself now needs two stamps and a witness.

HUB: Security Stamp Maze says the backup stamp is in transit. So is everyone else's confidence.
A clerk whispered that the stamp drawer is alphabetized by feeling now. Bad sign.

beats.title: Administrative Resolution
beats.startText: The replacement stamp arrived. It is decorative. Desperanza is calling this progress anyway.

arcs.completedText: Paperwork update: the missing stamp was never required. Desperanza has filed the victory under process improvement.

arcs.name: A Bunk With A Door
arcs.summary: Save enough coins to dream of privacy in a city that treats privacy as a rumor.

beats.title: Window Shopping For Walls
beats.startText: {raider_name} has started pricing a bunk with a door. Desperanza real estate describes doors as a premium emotional feature.

HUB: Pawn Desk says a door is possible if expectations are load-bearing. {raider_name} is taking notes.
ComfortCo Warranty Clerk called curtains a gateway privacy product. Suspicious pitch.

beats.title: The Dream Gets Hinges
beats.startText: Coin stash is starting to look door-shaped. The dream now includes a latch and maybe one whole wall.

HUB: A Coupon Baron offered a bunk discount if the floor remains theoretical. Declined for now.
{raider_name} inspected three bunks today and disliked all of their public-facing energy.

beats.title: Almost Respectable Housing
beats.startText: {raider_name} now has enough coin to discuss door options seriously. Desperanza is nervous about this level of optimism.

arcs.completedText: Housing milestone reached: {raider_name} can now afford the idea of a bunk with a door, pending inspections, fees, and emotional surcharges.

arcs.name: Vending Machine Friendship
arcs.summary: A one-sided relationship with a machine that may or may not be listening.

beats.title: Mutual Recognition, Allegedly
beats.startText: A vending machine near the bunks hummed when {raider_name} walked by. Friendship has been declared unilaterally.

HUB: The vending machine lit up one extra button today. {raider_name} considers this growth.
Someone else used the vending machine and got normal snacks. Deeply suspicious.
RAIDING: Mid-raid thought: bring something nice back for the vending machine. Maybe a battery. Maybe closure.

beats.title: Gift Economy
beats.startText: {raider_name} is considering a peace offering for the vending machine. Desperanza advises against feeding machines emotionally.

HUB: Nearly Fresh Counter suggested buying the vending machine a snack. This feels circular and therefore profound.
The vending machine accepted a coin, then returned it. Boundaries have been established.

beats.title: Machine Rapport
beats.startText: The vending machine now rattles in what {raider_name} insists is a familiar tone. The rest of Desperanza remains unconvinced.

arcs.completedText: Relationship status updated: {raider_name} and the vending machine are now on nodding terms, which is healthier than several human arrangements down here.

arcs.name: The Intervention Crate
arcs.summary: Desperanza notices the stash problem and addresses it with concern, paperwork, and more shelving.

beats.title: Concerned Looks
beats.startText: Water bottle count reached double digits. Desperanza has upgraded from curiosity to concerned looks.

HUB: Water Ration Desk asked if the stash is a collection or a warning. {raider_name} said yes.
Pawn Desk suggested selling the extra bottles. The word 'extra' offended everyone involved.
RAIDING: Every new bottle still feels important to {raider_name}. This is how legends and problems begin.

beats.title: Shelf Planning
beats.startText: At {raider_name}'s current pace, the stash needs a shelving plan and perhaps a constitution.

HUB: A clerk suggested labeling the bottles by mood. The stash is not helping the mood situation.
Desperanza has begun measuring bottle quantities in architectural terms.

beats.title: The Bottled Future
beats.startText: Water bottle totals are now entering myth territory. Some residents believe {raider_name} is planning a tiny flood.

arcs.completedText: Intervention outcome: Desperanza failed to reduce the stash, but did concede that {raider_name} has achieved a recognizable lifestyle.

arcs.name: Machine Grudge Match
arcs.summary: A recurring robot problem graduates into a full-time personal feud.

beats.title: A Pattern Forms
beats.startText: {raider_name} has started using the word 'nemesis' about {nemesis_robot_name}, which is a strong word and currently the correct one.

HUB: Someone mentioned {nemesis_robot_name} over lunch. {raider_name} answered with details no one had requested.
The grudge against {nemesis_robot_name} is now specific enough to require diagrams.
RAIDING: Every loud chassis in the distance now gets one immediate question: is that {nemesis_robot_name} again?

beats.title: Professional Resentment
beats.startText: The feud with {nemesis_robot_name} has matured into planning. Desperanza is calling that growth because 'obsession' felt rude.

HUB: {raider_name} described three separate revenge plans today. Two involved paperwork somehow.
A clerk suggested forgiving {nemesis_robot_name}. Everyone laughed like it was a joke.

beats.title: Documented Hostility
beats.startText: The conflict with {nemesis_robot_name} now has witnesses, speculation, and its own corner of the gossip circuit.

arcs.completedText: Grudge update: the feud with {nemesis_robot_name} is now part of Desperanza folklore, which is cheaper than therapy and louder than wisdom.
